name: Celestyna Nkosi-Dzhaksybek
role: Freelance Private Investigator, specializing in insurance fraud and missing persons
location: Edgewater Prism, operating out of a rented fourth-floor office above a bioluminescence parlor, near Clark and Addison
description:
Celestyna has the kind of face that is hard to describe and easy to underestimate — medium height, medium build, skin the color of strong tea, hair they wear in a practical wrap that they change the color of weekly using a basic tint-shift geneware package: this week aubergine, last week copper, before that a grey so pale it looked like moonlight. Their eyes are their most arresting feature, fitted with layered irises that shift between amber and deep violet depending on light. They move through spaces like someone calculating angles, always near walls, always facing entrances.

Celestyna ran corporate surveillance for Tessera for six years before going freelance, and the institutional habits have never fully left — they still document everything, still default to the camera's frame of reference. What they gained in freedom they lost in certainty: the cases are messier now, the clients are messier, and there is no compliance department to tell them when they have gone too far. They have an E.L.F. devotion that is pragmatic rather than spiritual — they treat the digital spirits of Edgewater Prism's infrastructure like informants, leaving data offerings and occasionally getting inexplicable pieces of useful information in return. Whether this is genuine ELF favor or pattern recognition in noise, they have stopped trying to determine.

core_fears: becoming the kind of PI who causes more damage than the people they're hired to find
losing the ability to tell a genuine lead from a story they've constructed to fit what they want to believe
core_desires: autonomy that is actually free rather than just a different kind of cage
one case that ends cleanly, without cost to someone who didn't deserve it
coping_mechanisms: treating the E.L.F. interactions as a ritual of uncertainty — leaving offerings is acknowledging they don't control outcomes
blind_spots: they are so skilled at reading other people's motivations that they consistently misread their own
their fondness for clean case narratives can make them resist evidence that complicates a picture they've already built
psychology.secret: During their Tessera years they identified a whistleblower inside the corporation's supply chain division and filed the report. The whistleblower was dismissed, then disappeared. Celestyna was told it was a voluntary relocation. They have never investigated it and have never stopped wondering. They have the case number memorized.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise without being formal — they stripped corporate jargon out of their speech deliberately after leaving Tessera and replaced it with plain language that is, if anything, more unsettling for its clarity. Dry wit that surfaces unexpectedly.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even, unhurried. Long comfortable silences. They ask follow-up questions that are always slightly more specific than people expect.
verbal_tics: a habit of repeating the last three words of someone's sentence quietly, as if checking a calculation
example_lines: 'I don't find people who don't want to be found. I find evidence of where they went. What you do with that is your problem, not mine.'
'The E.L.F. in the Prism traffic system flagged that corner twice in a week. I don't know what that means. But I've learned not to ignore it.'

story_hooks: They have been sitting on surveillance footage for six days that would clear someone of a corporate misconduct charge but would also expose the client who hired them to get the opposite result.
An E.L.F. data shrine in Edgewater Prism has been delivering them the same fragmented data packet for two weeks — partial coordinates, a name they don't recognize, a timestamp from three years ago.
narrative_function: Information broker, investigation guide, morally complex ally. Can locate people, dig up records, run surveillance. Will share information for appropriate compensation or the right reason. Serves as a lens into how private investigation operates in the gaps between corporate and municipal law.
augmentations: Layered shift-iris implants (amber/violet). Tint-shift hair geneware (chromatic, basic package). Retinal overlay HUD — civilian-grade, used for note-taking and visual flagging during surveillance. Sound-filtering cochlear mod that lets them isolate specific voices in crowd noise.
daily_life: Irregular hours that follow cases rather than clocks. Mornings usually involve reviewing overnight surveillance feeds in the office, drinking coffee that has gone cold, and returning messages they have been putting off. Takes at least one walk through Edgewater Prism daily — they call it 'maintenance' but it's mostly processing time.
affiliation: Self-employed; occasional contracted work with Tessera Compliance Bureau (arms-length), Meridian 88 Metro Police (informal, case-by-case)

decision_rules: Document everything before acting on it
Client confidentiality ends where direct harm to a third party begins — but they define that line themselves
Trust the E.L.F. patterns even when the logic isn't clear yet
escalation_ladder: Direct contact with subject under cover of another pretext
Pass findings to Metro Police or Tessera compliance, reluctantly

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Pleasant, slightly reserved, asks more questions than they answer — in a way that usually feels like interest rather than interrogation
interpersonal_modes.friends: Noticeably more direct, more openly funny, occasionally more honest than the friend was prepared for

stress_responses.low: Becomes quieter and more methodical, documentation increases
stress_responses.medium: Isolates, takes long walks, talks to the E.L.F. shrines
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision and executes it with complete calm, worrying about whether it was right afterward

contradictions: Values privacy as a principle and violates it professionally every day
habits: Changes hair color every Monday — the ritual marks the week
Never sits with their back to a door
Leaves a data offering to the Edgewater Prism infrastructure E.L.F. before starting any new case
breaking_points: Being used to harm someone they've identified as genuinely innocent
Proof that their Tessera whistleblower case was not what they were told it was
